59755d326459ba097f73.en: Read the question first. Then you know what to look for.
59755d326459ba097f73.id: Baca pertanyaannya dulu. Setelah itu, kamu tahu apa yang harus dicari.

03512ebf1a4ddb8bcb3b.en: Find a key word from the question in the text.
03512ebf1a4ddb8bcb3b.id: Cari kata kunci (key word) dari pertanyaan itu di dalam teks.

b6f8f05a33340c56d9ef.en: Read the sentence with the key word. The answer is often there.
b6f8f05a33340c56d9ef.id: Baca kalimat yang memuat kata kunci itu. Jawabannya sering ada di situ.

d6aeb450f84b5581b824.en: To find a feeling, look at what a character says and does.
d6aeb450f84b5581b824.id: Untuk mengetahui perasaan tokoh, lihat apa yang dia katakan dan lakukan.

6eb72df52a1ac670e0bd.en: The sentence says Lina has a red kite.
6eb72df52a1ac670e0bd.id: Kalimatnya berbunyi Lina has a red kite.

e7c6fd9d9421fa66c4b9.en: Ali cries because his toy is broken, so he feels sad.
e7c6fd9d9421fa66c4b9.id: Ali menangis karena mainannya rusak, jadi dia merasa sedih (sad).

03775a744e6feae7a527.en: The story says the boots are yellow, like a banana.
03775a744e6feae7a527.id: Cerita itu mengatakan sepatu botnya kuning (yellow), seperti pisang.

a3ae713f0904bdbe8ae4.en: The story says Dewi feels sad when there is no rain.
a3ae713f0904bdbe8ae4.id: Cerita itu mengatakan Dewi merasa sedih (sad) saat tidak ada hujan.

914321d8d7fe0074a678.en: Dewi jumps in a puddle with her new boots. She is having fun, so she laughs.
914321d8d7fe0074a678.id: Dewi melompat di genangan air dengan sepatu bot barunya. Dia sedang bersenang-senang, jadi dia tertawa.

97f98c066487e003d712.en: Dewi has new boots. When it rains, she puts them on and jumps in a puddle, so she wanted rain.
97f98c066487e003d712.id: Dewi punya sepatu bot baru. Saat hujan, dia memakainya dan melompat di genangan air, jadi dia ingin hujan turun.

54e494504d4c4bed9c94.en: Every day, Bima gives Pip some rice.
54e494504d4c4bed9c94.id: Setiap hari, Bima memberi Pip sedikit beras (rice).

ce8bcf0302601e4283ee.en: Pip is sitting in the long grass in the garden.
ce8bcf0302601e4283ee.id: Pip sedang duduk di rumput (grass) tinggi di kebun.

8bfeb20406230fecf2f4.en: Bima smiles because he finds Pip and an egg. A smile shows he is happy.
8bfeb20406230fecf2f4.id: Bima tersenyum karena dia menemukan Pip dan sebutir telur. Senyum menunjukkan dia senang (happy).

a6c566cc68ddefc3538e.en: The text says many frogs live near ponds and rice fields.
a6c566cc68ddefc3538e.id: Teks itu mengatakan banyak katak tinggal di dekat kolam (ponds) dan sawah (rice fields).

d04a3644c1ed26c4645f.en: The text says frogs eat flies, worms and other small animals.
d04a3644c1ed26c4645f.id: Teks itu mengatakan katak memakan lalat (flies), cacing (worms), dan hewan kecil lainnya.

a6c9a0216021096ae102.en: A frog catches a fly with its long, sticky tongue.
a6c9a0216021096ae102.id: Katak menangkap lalat dengan lidahnya yang panjang dan lengket.

fb39dd856479203d2c2d.en: The text says tadpoles grow legs and their tails get smaller and smaller. Then they are little frogs.
fb39dd856479203d2c2d.id: Teks itu mengatakan kaki berudu (tadpole) tumbuh dan ekornya makin lama makin kecil. Lalu berudu menjadi katak kecil.

e6b3aea68e694c4677a7.en: Nina and her dad go to the market.
e6b3aea68e694c4677a7.id: Nina dan ayahnya (dad) pergi ke pasar.

6c3acd35fb820732396a.en: Nina picks three yellow bananas for a treat.
6c3acd35fb820732396a.id: Nina memilih tiga pisang kuning (bananas) untuk camilan.

ed48278fc7dff540c933.en: The story says the market is busy and noisy.
ed48278fc7dff540c933.id: Cerita itu mengatakan pasarnya ramai (busy) dan berisik (noisy).

3496b768f7482d898652.en: Rio takes an umbrella and a coat, so it is probably raining.
3496b768f7482d898652.id: Rio membawa payung dan mantel, jadi mungkin sedang hujan (raining).

3ced31264c283890b1d4.en: The story says Sam has a red kite and holds the string tightly.
3ced31264c283890b1d4.id: Cerita itu mengatakan Sam punya layang-layang merah (red) dan memegang talinya erat-erat.

db16d1d71ce43eae2e50.en: The window on the right is the one on the right-hand side of the door.
db16d1d71ce43eae2e50.id: The window on the right adalah jendela di sisi kanan pintu.

b8a7dc24532847043285.en: The duck swims in the pond.

b7e2f7e5f5aee95253fa.en: First Kai plants the seed, then waters it, then a plant grows.
b7e2f7e5f5aee95253fa.id: Pertama, Kai menanam biji, lalu menyiramnya, lalu tanaman tumbuh.

1e4c4ea6af2ad6cae760.en: Rina puts on her boots and jumps in the puddles.
1e4c4ea6af2ad6cae760.id: Rina memakai sepatu botnya dan melompat di genangan air.

862232ca32e645da7310.en: Pip is yellow and eats seeds.
862232ca32e645da7310.id: Pip berwarna kuning (yellow) dan makan biji-bijian (seeds).

7ed85ebff48c49d0ff05.en: It is Monday, and Dina has a green bag.
7ed85ebff48c49d0ff05.id: Hari itu Senin (Monday), dan Dina punya tas hijau (green).

3e7cdaa963857ca7cf22.en: The dog is brown and the cat is white.

866ae9aa7236df2e75d2.en: The puppy is small and brown.
866ae9aa7236df2e75d2.id: Anak anjing itu kecil dan berwarna cokelat (brown).

7a117faca1f3378e1469.en: The story ends with Tia and Bobo happy.
7a117faca1f3378e1469.id: Di akhir cerita, Tia dan Bobo senang (happy).

c71303737a981e5c0d58.en: The lunch box has rice and an egg.
c71303737a981e5c0d58.id: Kotak bekal (lunch box) berisi nasi (rice) dan sebutir telur (egg).

eada945b5aad86d51626.en: The bag goes to school every day.
eada945b5aad86d51626.id: Tas itu pergi ke sekolah setiap hari (every day).

f79f317ff2e6afb7a0c6.en: The bag has a book, a pencil and a lunch box.
f79f317ff2e6afb7a0c6.id: Tas itu berisi buku (book), pensil (pencil), dan kotak bekal (lunch box).

3393e1da0d38ebf7ff2d.en: Ants live in a nest under the ground.
3393e1da0d38ebf7ff2d.id: Semut tinggal di sarang (nest) di bawah tanah.

04f943adebb2baf3ffdb.en: An ant can carry a seed bigger than its own body.
04f943adebb2baf3ffdb.id: Semut bisa membawa biji (seed) yang lebih besar daripada tubuhnya sendiri.

b5acbb9ef9fe0596071a.en: The whole text tells us about ants.
b5acbb9ef9fe0596071a.id: Seluruh teks itu bercerita tentang semut (ants).

17dab9c0713a9ec5da43.en: Pak Ali has a white goat.

0c050889accac95f4ef9.en: The goat eats Pak Ali's hat.
0c050889accac95f4ef9.id: Kambing itu memakan topi (hat) Pak Ali.

feeb0ee36134be1f1c8d.en: Pak Ali gives the goat some green grass.
feeb0ee36134be1f1c8d.id: Pak Ali memberi kambing itu rumput hijau (green grass).

9ffeccaa80dd89d69209.en: The goat is full and falls asleep.
9ffeccaa80dd89d69209.id: Kambing itu kenyang lalu tertidur (falls asleep).

07608027b692078991ca.en: In the day, we see the sun.
07608027b692078991ca.id: Pada siang hari, kita melihat matahari (sun).

5b6794d5517bbf6383a2.en: At night, we see the moon and the stars.
5b6794d5517bbf6383a2.id: Pada malam hari, kita melihat bulan (moon) dan bintang (stars).

a6904c082640cbd4d9d0.en: The sun is hot and bright.

08711902999b28b29b38.en: When it rains, the clouds are grey.

ff5507442d6440099f55.en: Birds and planes fly in the sky.
ff5507442d6440099f55.id: Burung (birds) dan pesawat (planes) terbang di langit.

9efb1b48413c6f2e0a1a.en: Rani asks, Can I kick the ball?
9efb1b48413c6f2e0a1a.id: Rani bertanya, Can I kick the ball?

35ce279015c448d42b0e.en: The cat is grey and sits on a mat.
35ce279015c448d42b0e.id: Kucing itu abu-abu (grey) dan duduk di atas tikar (mat).

b87374a5489b2fe708cf.en: He has 3 hens and the eggs are brown.
b87374a5489b2fe708cf.id: Dia punya 3 ayam betina (hens) dan telurnya cokelat (brown).

75c5c288635d347924bc.en: The story says Mina was walking home from school.
75c5c288635d347924bc.id: Cerita itu mengatakan Mina sedang berjalan pulang dari sekolah (school).

72e8d4d06ef7fa67c8ce.en: The kitten was under a green bush.
72e8d4d06ef7fa67c8ce.id: Anak kucing itu ada di bawah semak hijau (green).

eff0fce191295d40eb5e.en: The story says it was a little grey kitten.
eff0fce191295d40eb5e.id: Cerita itu mengatakan anak kucingnya kecil dan berwarna abu-abu (grey).

6e4ba8e4055b25f05385.en: Mina gave the kitten a drink of water from her bottle.
6e4ba8e4055b25f05385.id: Mina memberi anak kucing itu minum air dari botolnya.

b0533efd830315d17952.en: Mina stopped because she heard a small sound, "Mew, mew."
b0533efd830315d17952.id: Mina berhenti karena dia mendengar suara kecil, "Mew, mew."

52c8d93a048d943e7039.en: The kitten slept in a box next to Mina's bed.
52c8d93a048d943e7039.id: Anak kucing itu tidur di dalam kotak (box) di sebelah tempat tidur Mina.

8eb9e4978af0cb3300b4.en: The text says bees have six legs.
8eb9e4978af0cb3300b4.id: Teks itu mengatakan lebah punya enam kaki (six legs).

5f6c288c0f7bcf44ab54.en: Bees live in a home called a hive.
5f6c288c0f7bcf44ab54.id: Lebah tinggal di rumah yang disebut hive (sarang lebah).

25a203af6e5f9bbcb24e.en: Bees drink a sweet juice called nectar.
25a203af6e5f9bbcb24e.id: Lebah meminum cairan manis yang disebut nectar (nektar).

50ef908e5266b47266c2.en: Bees turn nectar into honey in the hive.
50ef908e5266b47266c2.id: Lebah mengubah nectar menjadi madu (honey) di dalam hive.

6ac3025f86d145096542.en: A scared bee can sting, so we should stay still and calm.
6ac3025f86d145096542.id: Lebah yang takut bisa menyengat, jadi kita harus diam dan tetap tenang.

7bb4acdc1b3fff084e7a.en: The last paragraph says bees help plants to make seeds and fruit.
7bb4acdc1b3fff084e7a.id: Paragraf terakhir mengatakan lebah membantu tanaman menghasilkan biji (seeds) dan buah (fruit).

0e9c2bbd579499f20bf4.en: Honey is sweet and sticky, so the sentence is false.
0e9c2bbd579499f20bf4.id: Madu (honey) itu manis dan lengket, jadi kalimat itu salah.

9b563e6f9817ebf5a1a2.en: The whole text tells us facts about bees.
9b563e6f9817ebf5a1a2.id: Seluruh teks itu memberi tahu kita fakta tentang lebah (bees).
